tachichi.bio: Halifax rapper Tachichi is a veteran of Canadian underground hip-hop whose solo catalogue and collective work connect him to the long-running Backburner scene.

taktika.bio: Lévis duo Taktika is a foundational Québec hip-hop group whose decades-long French-language catalogue has helped define and popularize rap québécois.

tal bachman.bio: Winnipeg-born singer-songwriter and guitarist Tal Bachman is a Canadian pop-rock artist best known for the international 1999 hit She's So High.

tanya tagaq.bio: Cambridge Bay artist Tanya Tagaq is a Canadian Inuk throat singer, songwriter, novelist and visual artist whose experimental solo vocal work won the Polaris Music Prize.

tara chase.bio: Montréal-born rapper Tara Chase is a pioneering Canadian female MC who became part of Toronto's influential Circle collective and helped establish women in Canadian hip-hop during the 1990s.

tate mcrae.bio: Calgary-born singer-songwriter and dancer Tate McRae is a Canadian pop artist whose emotionally direct songwriting and dance background developed into a major international recording career.

tep no.bio: Toronto producer, DJ and electronic artist Tep No is a Canadian musician known for low-key tropical-house and dance-pop built around restrained beats, guitar and breathy vocals.

the 6th letter.bio: Toronto rapper The 6th Letter, born Kevon André Samuels, is a Canadian MC associated with the Bakers Club collective and Toronto's early-2010s underground rap wave.

the killjoys.bio: Hamilton band The Killjoys is a Canadian alternative-rock and power-pop group whose 1990s catalogue produced national radio singles including Today I Hate Everyone.

the kount.bio: Toronto producer and multi-instrumentalist The Kount is a Canadian beatmaker known for groove-heavy instrumental music that blends hip-hop, funk, jazz and contemporary R&B.

the new electric.bio: Calgary band The New Electric is a Canadian pop and alternative group formed in 2013 whose polished, hook-driven sound earned national radio and emerging-artist attention.

the odds.bio: Vancouver band Odds is a Canadian alternative-rock and power-pop group whose melodic songwriting produced a run of national hits and multiple Juno nominations.

the sarandons.bio: Toronto band The Sarandons makes Canadian indie rock and roots-oriented guitar music shaped by Americana, neo-psychedelia and tightly arranged melodic songwriting.

the slakadeliqs.bio: Toronto group The Slakadeliqs is a Canadian soul and R&B project fronted by producer Slakah the Beatchild, blending warm live instrumentation with modern soul songwriting.

the sorority.bio: Toronto group The Sorority was a Canadian hip-hop collective formed by Keysha Freshh, Lex Leosis, Haviah Mighty and pHoenix Pagliacci after a viral all-women cypher.

the strumbellas.bio: Lindsay, Ontario band The Strumbellas is a Canadian folk-rock and indie-pop group known for communal vocals, melodic hooks and the international breakthrough single Spirits.

these kids wear crowns.bio: Chilliwack band These Kids Wear Crowns is a Canadian power-pop and pop-rock group that broke nationally through MuchMusic's disBand and the album Jumpstart.

tim baker.bio: St. John's singer-songwriter Tim Baker is a Canadian indie-folk and rock artist best known as the longtime frontman of Hey Rosetta! and for his later solo catalogue.

tobi.bio: Lagos-born, Brampton-raised singer and rapper TOBi is a Nigerian-Canadian artist whose music moves through hip-hop, R&B, jazz, soul and Afrobeat.

top5.bio: Toronto rapper Top5, born Hassan Ali, is a Canadian hip-hop artist from Lawrence Heights whose drill-oriented music became a highly visible part of the city's 2010s rap scene.

tory lanez.bio: Brampton-born rapper, singer and songwriter Tory Lanez is a Canadian R&B and hip-hop artist whose mixtapes and albums produced a long run of major Canadian and U.S. chart entries.

trevor guthrie.bio: North Vancouver-born singer-songwriter Trevor Guthrie is a Canadian pop and dance vocalist known as the former frontman of soulDecision and for later electronic collaborations.

victoria duffield.bio: Abbotsford-born singer, songwriter, dancer and actor Victoria Duffield is a Canadian pop artist best known for the platinum-certified dance-pop single Shut Up and Dance.

virginia to vegas.bio: Virginia to Vegas is the project of Canadian singer-songwriter and producer Derik Baker, whose polished indie-pop and electronic singles have earned multiple platinum certifications in Canada.

webster.bio: Québec City rapper Webster, born Aly Ndiaye, is a Canadian hip-hop artist, educator and historian whose French-language work is closely tied to Black history and Québec culture.

wendy macisaac.bio: Cape Breton fiddler, pianist and step dancer Wendy MacIsaac is a Canadian traditional musician whose work carries forward Nova Scotia's Gaelic and Cape Breton music traditions.

white-b.bio: Montréal rapper White-B, born David Bouchard-Sasseville, is a Canadian francophone hip-hop artist and member of the 5sang14 collective known for melodic street rap.

why g.bio: Toronto rapper Why G is a Canadian hip-hop artist from the city's west end whose elastic delivery and menacing production became part of Toronto's modern street-rap sound.

yanchan produced.bio: Scarborough-born Canadian-Tamil producer, songwriter, engineer and mridangist Yanchan Produced blends Carnatic percussion and South Asian musical traditions with hip-hop, R&B and electronic production.
